headline: After Germany, the BMW i7 all-electric flagship sedan begins production in India for the first time
summary: BMW has begun local production of the i7 all-electric flagship sedan in India, a first for the model after Germany. The high-performance i7 M70 xDrive will still be imported as a completely built unit, priced at ₹2.65 crore.
why: BMW is a German premium carmaker, and India is a growing market for its electric models. Local assembly can affect costs and pricing for luxury EVs.

impacts.name: BMW
impacts.why: Starting i7 production in India extends BMW's local EV manufacturing footprint in a growing market.
